text: So, let me just, well, let me do it. When we have many access points that are connected with each other through the distribution system, and then as they stand, they are connected through a gateway with the internet, we refer to this network architecture as extended service set. Extended service set because it is not just a basic service set. It is not just one access point and the user connected to it, but we have an extended network with several access points, and with access points connected through the distribution system. So all this is an extended service set. Okay, good. So now there is a second possible type of architecture in Wi-Fi. That is the ad hoc architecture. Remember we mentioned that also yesterday. This is a possible network architecture in wireless networks. It is also referred to as device-to-device communication network, and this is implemented when we configure the Wi-Fi cards to talk to each other directly. So in that case, there is no access point, but the Wi-Fi wireless cards.
